name: Clay C. Clark
childhood_experience: Given up for adoption; raised by neighbors
notable_stories: Son of Mary Frances Vantine given up for adoption; raised by neighbors
Adopted by the family living next door to John Wesley Adams's family; lived prosperously and raised his own family. The preparer believes he has found Clay's descendants.
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Half-sibling of John Wesley Adams' children. Born 1860. Given up for adoption.
